### Abide in Him
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/abide-him
Passage: 1 John 2:28
Points:
- Abiding in Christ unites adherence to true doctrine with the pursuit of practical holiness.
- Living righteously reassures believers of their salvation because it mirrors the Father's character.
- True faith leads Christians to pursue obedience, confront sin, and depend on Christ's mercy.
- Remaining anchored in Christ enables believers to face His coming with confidence instead of shame.

### Day 329: 1 John 2:24–27
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-329-1-john-2-2427.html
Passage: 1 John 2:24
Points:
- Faithful devotion often unfolds in quiet, unseen service rather than public acclaim.
- When facing uncertainties, believers must remain anchored in what they have known from the beginning.
- Walking with Christ is a bold spiritual journey rather than a comfortable, passive routine.
- God takes ordinary individuals out of their secure comfort zones to become true disciples.
